correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 the graph is exactly the cubic 2n-cycle plus antipodal matching. Counting cut edges gives |S|>=n; n+1 consecutive cycle vertices supply universal upper bounds. The 16-state twisted local-transfer bijection is exact, with 26 permitted transitions. Exact Newton identities produce the 16 characteristic coefficients, and the 16 adjugate numerator coefficients are reconstructed by trace convolution, so the rational generating function is proved for all n. Its constant/linear diagonals yield the precise minimum and labelled multiplicity; standard-library verifier was replayed successfully, including full independent brute enumeration for n=2..9. Boundary n=2 (K4) is covered. Computation is a finite algebraic certificate embedded in the proof, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: A complete cardinality polynomial for all limited dominating sets on a natural infinite family of nonplanar vertex-transitive cubic graphs, together with a sharp mod-four change in optimum and the exact 4/2n/3n labelled optimizer census, supplies substantive family-specific information beyond a scalar general bound or a routine named substitution. The transfer formulation also gives a finite recurrence for every coefficient and a concrete test family for cubic domination structural conjectures. The family and invariant are mathematically motivated by recent cubic limited-domination papers.
